verdict.rationale: GitLab is a Git-based platform with core docs on working with Git, SSH keys/PATs for access, and repository/project management, with community evidence confirming real-world use for hosting and migrating repos (commit history, PRs, wiki, etc.). Commit history browsing and repo creation are core, well-documented GitLab features implicit in its platform description and confirmed by migration/import evidence. missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc snippet specifically describing the commit-history browsing UI or repo creation wizard, only general Git-workflow and API docs.
